# Bootstrapable EMA Workspace

## Main idea
EMA should be bootstrapable from a working combination of:
- OpenClaw
- Discord
- vault/QMD
- filesystem truth
- chronicle/review/recall habits

## Why
That gives a path from living system -> refined system -> native EMA app, instead of forcing a full rewrite before usefulness.
